question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
WITH item_rollup AS (
  SELECT ORDER_ID, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_LINE_COUNT, SUM(QUANTITY) AS ORDERED_UNITS
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.STAGING.STG_ZOMATO__ORDER_ITEM
  GROUP BY ORDER_ID
), classified_orders AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT, 0) = 0 THEN 'No item line'
      WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 'One item line'
      ELSE 'More than one item line'
    END AS ORDER_LINE_GROUP,
    i.ORDERED_UNITS
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.STAGING.STG_ZOMATO__ORDER o
  LEFT JOIN item_rollup i ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
  WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT
  ORDER_LINE_GROUP,
  COUNT(*) AS ORDER_COUNT,
  COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS SHARE_OF_ALL_2025_ORDERS,
  AVG(ORDERED_UNITS) AS AVG_ORDERED_UNITS_PER_ORDER
FROM classified_orders
GROUP BY ORDER_LINE_GROUP
ORDER BY CASE ORDER_LINE_GROUP WHEN 'One item line' THEN 1 WHEN 'More than one item line' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
action.metrics: 2025 recorded orders categorized by number of item lines; share denominator includes all 2025 orders, including those with no item line. Average ordered units is summed item quantity per order, averaged within the one-line and multi-line groups.

action.answer: Among 4,359,773 recorded orders in 2025, 3,052,089 had more than one item line: 70.005700% of all orders. Average ordered units per order were 1.219753 for the 1,307,684 one-line orders and 3.484769 for the 3,052,089 multi-line orders. There were 0 orders with no item line.
